---
title: "quarto-version-selector"
---

A version selector dropdown for Quarto websites. The selector appears in the
navbar once the site is deployed with `quarto-version-selector deploy`, which
writes a `versions.json` file to the root of the docs branch.

Inspired by the [mike](https://github.com/jimporter/mike) plugin for mkdocs.
